Priya Kapoor: Kicking off the air-gapped on‑prem VPC delivery for Customer Zenith. Target handoff tomorrow 14:00 PT. I pasted a trimmed checklist below — need a validation owner (Jordan) and network owner (Alex).

Alex Chen: I can own the network signoff. Quick q: are we shipping pre-seeded container images or doing an on-site sync?

Priya Kapoor: Pre-seeded OCI images on encrypted USB + an offline registry seed is the plan. Samir, can you confirm the image signing step?

Samir Patel: Yep. We'll provide signed tarballs and an assurance script. Basic flow: mount USB, import to containerd registry, verify sha256 + signature. Example verify command I gave ops team: ```bash
sha256sum model-package.tar.gz
cosign verify-blob --key ksm://projects/zenith/key model-package.tar.gz.sig
```

Samir Patel: We'll also include an offline registry config snippet for containerd: ```toml
[plugins."io.containerd.grpc.v1.cri".registry.mirrors]
  "zenith-registry.local" = { endpoint = ["http://127.0.0.1:5000"] }
```

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4821 and attached signed artifacts. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/zenith-airgap. Escalation: oncall@redwood.io if any boot failures.

Jordan Lee: I'll take validation owner. Acceptance criteria: (1) all nodes boot with annotated roles, (2) kubelet + containerd pass image pull verification offline, (3) GPU drivers loaded and nvidia-smi shows all GPUs healthy, (4) inter-node MTU and BGP sessions match customer network policy.

Jordan Lee: Quick validation commands I'll run on site: ```bash
# nodes ready
kubectl get nodes -o wide
# verify GPU
kubectl -n kube-system exec -it gpu-check -- nvidia-smi -L
# simple inference smoke test (calls local model server)
curl --unix-socket /var/run/model.sock -X POST http://localhost/predict -d '{"text":"hello"}'
```

Alex Chen: Networking notes — customer network enforces 1500 MTU and private /22. We'll demand firewall rules for outbound update endpoints are blocked (airgap). BUT allow management VPN on UDP/4500 & TCP/443 to the customer jump host for kube-admin access. Confirmed with customer.

Priya Kapoor: Region constraint: their datacenter racks only have 2x 3-phase PDUs available. We trimmed GPU count to 4x A40 per rack to stay under power and cadence. That affects autoscaling headroom — Samir, include that in delivery notes so Dedicated capacity sizing team gets flagged for cost impact.

Samir Patel: Noted. Also recommend shipping a small spare GPU module and a spare NVMe for quick swap. I'll add a procurement note.

Alex Chen: One potential snag: the customer's edge router blocks BGP MED changes. We'll test peering in a staging stub first. If we can't establish full BGP, fallback: static routes + consolidated NAT on the customer jump. Jordan, can you validate routing fallback scripts?

Jordan Lee: Yup. I have a script that asserts routing table entries and runs path MTU checks. Will run it during acceptance.

Priya Kapoor: Delivery checklist (short):
- Signed images on USB (ops)
- Offline registry imported (ops)
- K8s nodes boot + labels (Jordan)
- GPU driver + nv peer mem checks (Jordan)
- BGP peering OR static fallback (Alex/Jordan)
- Audit logs exported to customer collector (compliance)
- Hand-off doc + runbook link provided to customer SREs

Alex Chen: For audit logs, customer asked for 90 days retention. We'll ship compressed logs to their sFTP nightly. Note: S3-type retention not available in airgap, it's a cost and storage ops item.

Samir Patel: Cost callout: because of constrained PDUs and conservative headroom, per-token inference cost will be ~12% higher than our baseline for this cluster. Flagging for pricing team.

Priya Kapoor: All right — Jordan and Alex, please confirm you can do final acceptance tomorrow 13:00 PT so we can hand over at 14:00. Ops will arrive 11:00 for physical install.

Jordan Lee: Confirmed 13:00 PT acceptance window. I'll bring the routing fallback plan.

Alex Chen: Confirmed. I'll coordinate firewall rule signing with the customer and the VPN test at 13:15.

infra-bot: Reminder: upload runbook artifacts to INFRA-4821 before closing.

Priya Kapoor: Great. I'll post the final deliverable checklist after ops confirms install. :white_check_mark:
